newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australia names new foreign investment review boss.
newsitem.headline: Australia names new foreign investment review boss.

text.p: The Australia government on Wednesday named businessman and former senior central bank official John Phillips to head the Foreign Investment Review Board.
Treasurer Peter Costello said in a statement Phillips would take over from acting chairman Ken Stone frr a five-year term.
Stone would remain as a member of the board.
Major foreign investment in Australia is subject to a broad national interest test, overseen by the board.
Phillips is chairman of the Australian Gas Light Co, IBJ Australia Bank Ltd and deputy chairman of retailer Woolworths Ltd.
He has also worked for the Reserve Bank of Australia and was deputy governor and deputy chairman of the board from 1987 to 1992.
